Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Orchestrated priming checklist and ops readout

Hi all,

Attached is the final priming schedule and the runbook we'll use for Saturday's cutover window. Key asks before we start:

- Confirm BGP session hold timers and expectation for MP-BGP route advertisement (item 2.3 in the sheet).
- Confirm MTU checks will be executed as a pre-step on both leaf racks (we'll need results posted in the bridge channel).
- KV cache warmup: target 3M prefix priming requests over 10 minutes (see section 4) — we want token-level priming and model KV prefill to reduce first-token spikes.
- Observability: bump sampling to 100% for the first 30 minutes after cutover and capture traceroutes for any 5xx spikes.

Schedule is in priming-schedule.xlsx. Bridge playbook v2 is attached for reference (bridge-playbook-v2.md).

Please reply with explicit ACK and any blockers by EOD tomorrow. If Acme ops needs a shortened priming window, flag the specific constraints.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Program Manager, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- priming-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- bridge-playbook-v2.md (markdown runbook)

ACK from infra side with a couple of tweaks / clarifications:

1) BGP: recommend reducing hold-timer to 30s/90s for the test to speed failover validation — we'll restore production timers after the smoke window. See note in priming-schedule.xlsx (tab: bgp).
2) MTU: we'll run script mtu-check.sh across racks T-45 and post the output to the bridge channel.
3) KV warmup: the 3M prefix target is fine but let's do it as two 5-minute bursts separated by a 2-minute cool-down to observe warming behavior rather than one contiguous burst. That reduces cache thrash.
4) Observability: Michael, please confirm we can switch tracing to 100% for the first 30m without hitting retention quotas; if not we apply a short high-sample window and then drop to 10%.

Thanks Monica — ACKs from Acme ops with a couple of questions:

- For KV warmup: can you share the synthetic traffic profile? our edge devices can only sustain ~350 req/s per appliance. If the priming script assumes 2k/s we need to distribute across more hosts.
- For the observability burst: Tom Reeves (ops lead) and I are okay with 100% sampling for 30m but can we gate it to service-level (not infra-level) to avoid sensitive PII being sampled? If not, please define a short approved list of trace attributes.

Tom is looped (tom.reeves@acmebank.com) — he'll coordinate appliance allocation.

Sarah Liu
Senior Ops Manager, Acme Bank

Preliminary smoke run executed in staging this morning — attaching a quick CSV summary (smoke-results-20270428.csv). High-level notes:

- KV prefix priming (2x 5m bursts) completed. Median token latency during priming: 42ms; 95th: 210ms (a few tail events tied to cache misses we instrumented).
- No BGP session flaps observed during simulated failover. Convergence times within expected bounds for 30s/90s timers.
- MTU checks surfaced one host with MTU mismatch (host-04) — fixed and revalidated.
- Tracing: we can route service-level spans to a short-term high-sample collector and exclude payload fields. Storage quotas look OK for a 30m window in our retention model.

Quick operational note after reviewing Michael's smoke CSV: we observed a ~2.3s NTP drift in one of the edge appliances during the second burst (recorded at 11:08). It didn't impact traffic throughput but could skew TLS handshake timestamps and make post-cutover log correlation harder. Recommendation: add a 15-minute NTP-only priming window immediately before the first KV burst to allow stratum resync across appliances.

I suggest the new sequence (T minus):
- T-30m: MTU & BGP sanity + NTP-only priming (15m)
- T-15m: KV warmup burst 1 (5m)
- T-8m: cool-down (2m)
- T-6m: KV warmup burst 2 (5m)
- Cutover 

If Acme ops agrees, I'll update bridge-playbook-v2.md with the NTP step and post a delta to the runbook.

Thanks everyone — decision and next steps:

1) Accepted Laura's recommendation — we'll add the 15-minute NTP priming window before KV bursts. I've updated bridge-playbook-v2.md and reattached the delta.
2) Observability: Michael confirmed service-level 100% sampling for 30m with payload exclusion. Acme ops (Tom) okayed appliance distribution — Sarah/Tom will post host allocation in the bridge channel.
3) KV warmup will run as two 5-minute bursts (as Karthik suggested) separated by a 2-minute cool-down. Monica will trigger the priming script and confirm completion in the bridge.
4) BGP timers will be reduced for the smoke window (30s/90s) and restored after the quiet window.

Go: we'll enter the orchestrated priming at the scheduled start if no new issues are posted in the next 2 hours. After the priming window completes, Michael will upload the full smoke CSV into the ticket (RED-2043) and I'll run the post-priming checklist.

Thanks for the rapid responses — appreciate the attention to detail.
